finding.evidence: L'en-tête Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy est absent : votre page peut être utilisée pour accéder à des ressources protégées d'autres domaines via des attaques mémoire avancées.
finding.description: Ajoutez l'en-tête HTTP Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless à votre serveur web. Vérifiez ensuite que vos intégrations tierces (connexion Google, cartes, widgets de paiement) fonctionnent toujours correctement.

State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix: send the response header `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless` from your web server, then verify third-party integrations (Google login, maps, payment widgets) still work. For third-party iframes that break under COEP, use iframe credentialless to load them in a new ephemeral context where COEP embedding rules can be lifted.

sources.contribution: The HTTP Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (COEP) response header configures the current document's policy for loading and embedding cross-origin resources that are requested in no-cors mode.
IFrame credentialless provides a mechanism for developers to load third-party resources in <iframe>s using a new, ephemeral context.
In return, the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (COEP) embedding rules can be lifted, so documents with COEP set can load third-party resources.

patch:
diff --git a/server.js b/server.js
index d1ca314..7f643ed 100644
--- a/server.js
+++ b/server.js
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ const HEADERS = {
   'referrer-policy': 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
   'permissions-policy': 'geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), interest-cohort=()',
   'cross-origin-opener-policy': 'same-origin-allow-popups',
+  'cross-origin-embedder-policy': 'credentialless',
   'content-security-policy': "frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'",
   server: 'nginx',
 };
